name: rtk
author: ismoil
description: Tokens saved by rtk today in the bar, and a popup per period: chart by hour or day, totals matching rtk gain, hook rewrites, projects with their worktrees and top commands. Readable for low vision (text scaling, WCAG AA contrast), English and Russian.

barWidget.description: rtk token savings with a per-project breakdown

schema.label: Popup period
schema.description: today, the last 7 days, or all time. The popup's buttons change it too.

schema.label: rtk history database
schema.description: Leave empty for rtk's own location (~/.local/share/rtk/history.db).

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (Russian or English).

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Scales the popup text. Text is never smaller than 13 px.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Turn off to stop the meters and columns from sliding.

schema.label: Re-read at most every (seconds, at least 5)
schema.description: The widget re-reads the history only when rtk wrote to it (the folder is watched), at most this often, and every 10 minutes regardless.
